bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are admitted after search; nonclear bags receive additional inspection.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The theatre has no private lot and prohibits parking on Hamilton Place. Boston Common Garage and Center Plaza Garage are nearby.
